title: Tiny, cute aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-blue glow backdrop omitted; canvas only -->
  <!-- wings -->
  <path d='M22 52 L50 44 L78 52 L50 58 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M22 52 L50 44 L50 58 Z' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M30 40 L18 26 L20 40 Z' fill='#ef476f'/>
  <path d='M30 40 L18 26 L30 36 Z' fill='#ff85a1'/>
  <!-- tail wing -->
  <path d='M30 40 L14 48 L30 46 Z' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <!-- fuselage body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='46' rx='26' ry='10' fill='#ef476f'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='42' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#ff85a1'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='46' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='42' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- cockpit windows -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <!-- side portholes -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='2' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='2' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='2' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <!-- propeller hub -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='46' r='3' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <!-- spinning propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='46' rx='2' ry='12' fill='#c3fce4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='46' rx='12' ry='2' fill='#c3fce4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- underline shade for body edge -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q52 58 76 52' stroke='#c9184a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
